svg.title: Board after the operations
svg.desc: Failures: / provider down -> messages wait in the queue, retried / zone lost -> two zones take the load (planned 50% extra) / Targets: accept 99.99%; push 5 s, SMS 30 s, email 1 min for 99% / Watch: accept errors and latency, / delivery time per channel against its target, / queue lag, errors per provider / Overload: marketing waits, security codes go first; a limit per team / Release: a few servers, then one zone at a time; roll back on errors
